name: Old House of Keys
scope: The standing Georgian Old House of Keys museum, its two-storey frontage, columned entrance, stepped rear, slate roofs and chimneys.
era: The restored standing museum exterior, returned to its appearance around 1866.

originalReview.notes: The exact published Qualla image matches the sole cropped file, which removed four pixels around the border from Finn Bjorklid’s native first-revision self-released public-domain image. The unchanged scene shows the square frontage, porch, roof, stacks and side wall.

review.method: Exactly matched public-domain originals, native building footprint and published architectural dimensions.
review.notes: The Qualla story’s published photograph was inspected and its mechanical border removal was matched to the photographer’s exact PD original. Manx National Heritage confirms the entrance width and restored appearance.
